title: Crypto Chicken Run
tagline: Easy and colourful game three.js based game with NFTs super powers added!
description: With crypto chicken run you can never be bored. With a flawless blockchain and NFT integration, I have created a game that can be played by anyone, and then you can earn NFTs to upgrade your character with perks. Have an integrated burning mechanism in the game to create gamification of the characters.
how_its_made: It is made using the Polygon, Moralis, and IPFS, NFT-Port, covalent, TableLand stack. I have used express as backend and simple HTML js and three.js in the frontend. Implemented a game using this stack. Stored the blockchain data like scores and perks. I have also used Sequence wallet as well as Moralis to give users an option to connect to the blockchain.
